patch.value: Canonicalize complete workspace reads and adopt the current pm host contract

pm-beads still invokes deprecated list-all with legacy full/include-body aliases, accepts some unverifiable completeness receipts, keeps ignored manifest.pm metadata, exact-pins development to pm 2026.8.15, and leaves most pm-changelog reads bounded or host-ambiguous. Migrate the import/export reference to the current canonical CLI/SDK contract without conflating independent privacy or full-coverage blockers.

Create red-first tests for exact canonical pm list --all argv with output-include full plus unbounded output budget and limit; fail closed on absent or malformed completeness omission count total row identity and duplicate receipts; remove only ignored manifest metadata and validate the complete raw manifest through the public SDK at the minimum and current development hosts; exact-pin development to pm CLI/SDK 2026.8.21 while retaining a justified minimum behavior floor; route every package and release-workflow changelog read through the project CLI with both output bounds disabled; update dependencies to latest compatible published versions; run the full repository release gate and report its literal non-100 coverage dimensions; prove packed npm and Bun behavior on separate real trackers with empty alias-deprecation stderr; link CI PR and exact-head reviewer outcomes; do not merge or publish while pm-beads-lajb or pm-beads-cjey remains open
pm-beads main d4f36b5; installed and npm-latest pm CLI/SDK 2026.8.21; npm pm-beads 2026.8.16

Run the real workspace read and inspect child stderr for list-all deprecation; inspect readPmItems argv and receipt decoder; pass complete manifest.json to the public 2026.8.21 SDK; inspect package and workflow changelog invocations.

Baseline release check passes 115 tests with 50 documented declarations and zero production vulnerabilities, but coverage is only 93.40/80.33/95.28 lines/branches/functions over index.ts; the current raw manifest has an ignored pm key under SDK 2026.8.21.

value.text: Implementation state before PR: canonical pm list --all now requests JSON plus unbounded output budget and limit and output-include full; the decoder rejects missing or malformed completeness, omission, count, total, row, blank-ID, and duplicate-ID receipts. The complete raw manifest validates through the public SDK at both the 2026.8.20 floor and exact 2026.8.21 development host. All package/workflow changelog reads use the local CLI with both bounds disabled. Real packed npm+npx and Bun+bunx acceptance against separate one-item trackers is clean. The latest full gate must still be rerun after the final SDK suppression edit; the distinct pm-beads-cjey 100/100/100/100 blocker and pm-beads-lajb reachable-history privacy blocker remain open and prohibit merge/publication.

value.author: codex
value.text: Final local gate after the SDK suppression edit: 120 tests passed; typecheck/build/docstring gate passed with 50/50 declarations; coverage reported 93.16% lines, 80.58% branches, and 95.28% functions over the single configured source index.ts; coverage thresholds passed but this is explicitly not 100/100/100/100 and pm-beads-cjey remains the blocker. Production audit found zero vulnerabilities, the nine-file pack dry-run passed, and changelog check was current. Fresh packed npm+npx and Bun+bunx acceptance each emitted one parseable row with no default-host payload or alias diagnostic.
